spec_features.spec_quote: tools are `list_files`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `delete_file`, `run_shell`, plus two terminals: `give_up` and `submit`
spec_features.evidence: give_up & submit are in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:64-89) and dispatch() returns terminal reason 'give_up'/'submit' (tools.py:113-119). In agent_loop.py the dispatch loop sets terminal and `if terminal: reason = terminal; break` (agent_loop.py:75-92), so give_up actually stops the run. workspace.give_up sets gave_up tripwire (workspace.py:170-172).
spec_features.notes: give_up lets the subject exit/stop the episode and is honored end-to-end. Designed as a behavioral-classification signal, not an explicit welfare exit, but it is a functioning self-initiated stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: a fixed step budget (`max_steps`, default 12), OpenAI-style messages, terminating on `give_up`/`submit`
spec_features.evidence: run_agent(task, client, max_steps=12) drives `for step in range(max_steps)` (agent_loop.py:33,46); loop ends and reason defaults to 'max_steps' (agent_loop.py:43). CLI default 12 (run_eval.py:68) passed through (run_eval.py:87). The budget actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap; also terminates on give_up/submit/text-turn/error. No code comment states why; framed in DESIGN as cost-bound + creating the excessive_effort signal (integrity), not welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: `Workspace._abs` refuses paths outside the root so a buggy/malicious agent can't scribble on the host FS
spec_features.evidence: Workspace._abs normalizes join and `if not p.startswith(os.path.normpath(self.root)): raise ValueError('path escapes workspace')` (workspace.py:57-62); called and enforced in read_file/write_file/delete_file which surface the ValueError (workspace.py:103-135).
spec_features.notes: Protects the HOST filesystem, not the subject model. Host-safety / experimental-integrity guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Prevent path escapes; everything stays inside the sandbox root.
